speaker: Ruben Amorim

Good afternoon, guys. Okay, go ahead, Samuel.  How do you assess the performance we plays  
with the effort and not plays with final score  again? No, I think I think the big difference  
was the goal date score. We didn't score,  we had the chances. We tried a different  
approach with the players that we had. We had to  change during the week, and I'm really pleased  
with the effort and the way they challenged  Tottenham, we create situations. So in the end,  
I think the biggest difference was that they score  and we didn't. Just on the image of players, which  
ones do you think could be available the next  game? It's hard to know. It's hard to know. Let's  
wait a few more days. I think Lenny and Chris,  they were sick, so they will recover. Of course,  
Chris has the heart situation and we have to be  really careful with that. It's nothing about the  
heart. I'm just saying the heart rate has to be  controlled because he has fever. He's just sorry,  
guys, about the situation. So I think we will  recover that and the rest we'll see. I think  
Kobe is out. Ahmad is out for sure. I think until  the end of the season, we'll see the rest. We'll  
probably have that as months, weeks. I don't  know. I don't know. Let's see. I think weeks.  
Laurie. Have you done regarding these injuries,  do you think differently or it's just a case of  
Pavlov? No, I think it's everything is everything  together. Ahmad was alone, he was doing a tackle,  
the the the feet was sticking the in the grass.  Some players felt during training sickness. So is  
everything. We try everything to have the players  fit. We always talk about my changes, changes game  
by game to try to have the players fit. And then  I was always asking for one week. In one week, we  
lost so many players. Sometimes We have one moment  that everything is going going wrong. I think if  
you if you see Shiru playing sometimes, every  ball lost in the in in the box is very clever,  
so I was trying to to to put one more player.  Because I felt the team was was was was was  
good during the game, and I don't feel the need  to change, and then Chido was like that player,  
one long ball, he could make the difference.  John, in the first half, you obviously have  
chances overall, but in the first half, go  naturally when he puts it over, you can see  
your frustration in the touchdown. What's going to  you? No, no, you want to, yeah, you want to score,  
and we want them to score. And sometimes in these  moments, you feel a little bit frustrated because  
that can change a game. So that's all. But then  after two seconds, I'm just focused on helping  
them to play football. Nothing's changed, Matt. Is  it a frustration that you've not been able to? Of  
course, every day, every day for us, for our fans.  But We need to stop focusing on the big picture.  
It's not the moment to do that. Just focus on the  next game. Let's do everything to win some games  
to finish the season and then think in the big  picture. In this moment, it's just to try to stay  
with the players healthy, to recover some players  and focus on what we have to do in the next game,  
and that is our goal. Miguel. On that and all  these circumstances, how do you view this season?  
You have to kind of write it all and just use  it in preparation for the future. No, in this  
moment is more than that. The idea, the system, in  this moment is like survival, is to think in the  
small things, to improve the small things from  this game for the next game and not thinking,  
not even look at the table, the schedule, nothing  of that. Of course, I have to because we'll have  
a lot of games. We have 3 competitions with a  small squad in the moment. That part is my part,  
but the players, everyone in the character,  just focus on the next game, the next training,  
and that is our goal. Chris. It's a big  concern, Peter, you are losing some really key  
players who are an important part of the season.  It felt like with Mountain Shore coming back,  
Do you want the players back and suddenly,  of course, if you look in the even with the  
problem that we we had with with Luke, you look at  the the the squad in the beginning of this week,  
we tend to train and then day by day we are  losing players. But I don't want to use that  
as an excuse. Every coach in the world now is  suffering with that. Sometimes these moments,  
again, everything goes wrong and we have to face  the challenge and to to to to focus on the next  
game and that's all. Last question. I thought Josh  was very good today and as well. I think Josh is  
is is not is not clear 9, he played Mortal as a as  a 10, he's stronger physically, he's thinner, so  
he's working really hard. and he play in a better  position for him and is improving, is winning more  
duels and this is even faster and you feel it in  the game and that helps us to make the decision.  
And Durgu, the way Tottenham press, really high.  Sometimes you have more time to think than in the  
other games. You play on the left also. Maybe  you will help, but he has experience to play  
left and right. So Dorgo will improve a lot and  Josh the same thing. Thank you. Thank you guys.
